description: This file defines the class Kint_Parsers_SplObjectStorage, which is a parser for SplObjectStorage objects in PHP, used within a debugging or inspection tool to display the contents of such objects.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_SplObjectStorage
classes.description: A parser class for handling SplObjectStorage objects, allowing extraction and formatting of stored objects for debugging purposes.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses an SplObjectStorage object to extract its contents and store information about the number and items stored.
